title: Quotation completeness and arithmetic
content: Required quotation fields must be present and declared totals must match deterministic calculations within the configured tolerance.

title: Discount approval authority
content: Discounts above ten percent require review by an authorised human. This fixture never records or grants that approval.

title: Restricted-party screening fixture
content: This synthetic fixture demonstrates exact-match routing only. It is not a current restricted-party source and cannot provide sanctions clearance.

title: Foreign-trade and export authorisation fixture
content: This synthetic rule demonstrates a missing-document block. It is not legal advice, authoritative country data, or export clearance.

title: Batch-pure delivery requirement fixture
content: This synthetic rule demonstrates routing when supplier confirmation is absent. It is not supplier evidence or product certification.

title: RIF governed reasoning contract
content: Reasoning must separate facts, assumptions, constraints, contradictions and uncertainty; cite approved evidence; calibrate confidence; abstain or route to human review when material evidence is insufficient; and never own the release decision.

title: Confirmed business rules
content: Every commercial rule comes from the tenant profile with an owner and a date. A placeholder rule may run, but every quotation that relies on it requires human review.

title: ERP evidence
content: Customers and items are verified read-only against the ERP. Unknown customers or items, credit holds and unavailable ERP data route to human review; blocked customers and items blocked for sale stop the quotation. Missing data is never filled in by the model.

title: Price floor and list-price deviation
content: The net unit price after discount must not fall below the ERP price floor plus the configured minimum margin. Deviations from the ERP list price beyond the configured tolerance require human review. Currencies are never converted implicitly.

title: Customer-facing document hygiene
content: The customer-facing quotation states prices and scope only. Internal pricing language, internal ERP cost figures and other customers' names must never appear in it.

title: Revisions and approval validity
content: A counter-offer is a numbered revision of the same quotation. A lower price for an unchanged scope means the margin moved and needs review. An approval covers exactly the decision basis it was given on and lapses on any change.
